scripts.dev:wait: turbo run dev > /tmp/dev-stack.log 2>&1 & bash scripts/wait-for-dev-stack.sh && echo "→ logs streaming to /tmp/dev-stack.log  (Ctrl-C the backgrounded turbo to stop)" && wait

apps/*/{app,components,lib,src}/**/*.{ts: sh -c 'app=$(echo "$1" | sed -E "s|apps/([^/]+)/.*|\1|" | head -1); pnpm --filter @lumaara/$app exec eslint --max-warnings 0' --
services/*/src/**/*.ts: sh -c 'svc=$(echo "$1" | sed -E "s|services/([^/]+)/.*|\1|" | head -1); pnpm --filter @lumaara/$svc exec tsc --noEmit' --
packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma: sh -c 'pnpm --filter @lumaara/db exec prisma validate && pnpm --filter @lumaara/db check:tenant-guard && pnpm --filter @lumaara/db check:tenant-index' --
